fan_said: Vinicius Junior spoke out right after the Roma match. He acknowledged he is in a slump, though he has no doubt he will regain his best form soon. But he feels referees are targeting him and wants proper protection for creative players like himself, Lamine Yamal, and Julian Alvarez.
India women start their three T20Is against Zimbabwe on Friday under new captain Smriti Mandhana, and vice-captain Shafali Verma promised they will play a fearless brand of cricket.
India men sit tied 2-2 against West Indies with one game left. After this series, they tour New Zealand for five T20Is, five ODIs, and two Tests starting October 22.
Here are the key upcoming fixtures in your time.
Saturday evening at 7:00 PM, the series decider: India face West Indies in the fifth T20I at M. Chinnaswamy Stadium right here in Bengaluru.
Then Thursday, October 22, a packed day. At 12:30 AM, Real Madrid play RB Leipzig in the Champions League at the Bernabéu.
And at 12:30 PM on Thursday, India open their New Zealand tour with the first T20I at Hagley Oval in Christchurch.
